impact: A scheduled job that assumes GitHub access silently degrades to a partial result, and a first-miss capability check misreports a transient disconnect as a permanent absence.
promotion_reason: single non-critical observation; collect another occurrence
suggested_change: Any scheduled prompt that needs an MCP tool must re-check availability through ToolSearch after a wait before declaring a fallback, and must state in its output which mode it ran in.
summary: Sessions started by a scheduled Routine cannot rely on MCP tools being present, and there is no HTTP fallback to GitHub.
